pages.title: The Silent Courtyard
paragraphs: The Cathedral gardens are untouched while smoke rises beyond the walls. Defeat Severin at the northern doors. Eveline alone can Talk to Corvis in the western walk.

This saved battle retains its original defenses: six advancing Cavaliers, garden Knights and overlapping central magic. Check ranges and use the outer walks. Progress warns one rear cavalry wave and one northern Raven wave, each arriving next turn.

pages.title: Hooves Behind the Gate
paragraphs: One finite wave of three level-20 Cavaliers arrives next turn at (11,29), (12,29) and (14,29). Your player phase comes before their first attacks. Occupied marked tiles queue arrivals without relocation.

pages.title: The Bell Answers
paragraphs: The bell sounds. The defenders do not look up.
Four level-18 Ravens arrive next turn at (1,3), (2,3), (23,3) and (24,3). Your player phase comes before their first attacks. This is the final finite wave; Severin remains the only victory target.

pages.title: The Last Door
paragraphs: Severin falls beneath the Cathedral doors. Behind the company, the fountain remains dry. Arlan lifts the latch. The Bishop is still inside.

pages.title: The Silent Courtyard
paragraphs: Beyond the smoke, the Cathedral courtyard is immaculate. Defeat General Severin at the northern doors. The reserve riders advance together when approached or attacked.

Optional: Eveline can Talk to Corvis in the western garden. Lena can steal Giant's Marrow from the western Sage. Inspect enemy ranges; the northern priest carries Freeze. Progress signals a finite rear cavalry wave with two player turns of warning.

A bell calls an optional Envoy and two Ravens to the eastern delivery court. In this saved encounter they guard that court only and never pursue outside it. Finish side objectives before defeating Severin; victory ends the chapter.

pages.title: The Silent Courtyard
paragraphs: Beyond the smoke, the Cathedral courtyard is immaculate. Pale paving runs between clipped hedges and low limestone walls. The fountain is dry. No worshippers wait here; only soldiers in golden armor.

Defeat General Severin at the northern doors. Clear the first riders, regroup south of the fountain, then break the northern guard. The reserve riders advance together when approached or attacked. Severin carries a range 1-2 Spear, Silver Axe and Silver Lance; he chooses the strongest usable attack on his turn and drops Spear.

Optional: Eveline can Talk to Corvis in the western garden. Lena can steal Giant's Marrow from the western Sage. Inspect enemy ranges; the northern priest carries Freeze. Progress signals a finite rear cavalry wave with two player turns of warning.

Mages and Sages hold until a target enters their movement-plus-attack range. A bell also calls an optional, stationary Envoy to the eastern delivery court. Three pairs of Ravens pursue freely: with the Envoy, then two and four turns after its actual arrival. Finish side objectives before defeating Severin; victory ends the chapter.

pages.title: A Familiar Voice
paragraphs: Eveline stops at the western garden. "Corvis. Come with us." His gaze moves from her bloodied sleeves to the untouched flowers. He closes his book.

Only Eveline can stand adjacent to living Corvis and choose Talk. Talking consumes her action. Corvis joins in his current condition, keeping his remaining HP and tome uses; recruitment is not a free heal. Without Eveline, he remains a defender, and defeating Severin still ends the chapter.

pages.title: An Answer Too Late
paragraphs: Corvis falls beside the dry fountain, his book closing against the pale stone. Whatever doubt he carried can no longer become a choice.
His recruitment is lost, but the chapter continues. There is no rescue objective to replace it. Keep the company together and defeat General Severin at the northern doors.

pages.title: Hooves Behind the Gate
paragraphs: An officer raises two fingers. Hooves answer beyond the southern ironwork.

One finite wave of three level-20 cavaliers will arrive in two turns, at the marked south gate and its staging tiles. You receive two player phases before their first attacks. They arrive before your player phase, never directly into an attack.

Occupied arrival tiles delay those units on their exact marked tiles; no rider is relocated behind your line. Cover the rear or keep advancing together. Crossing the midpoint again cannot call another wave.

pages.title: The Bell Calls an Envoy
paragraphs: The Cathedral bell gives a single measured stroke. Severin's officers tighten their formation as though this arrival was expected.

The Bell Envoy and two Ravens arrive next turn inside the eastern delivery court. Your player phase comes before their first attacks. In this saved encounter they guard that court only; stay outside its hedge opening to bypass them.
This is the final finite wave. Defeat the clawed Envoy for 5 Insight and its carried treasure. Severin remains the sole victory target.

pages.title: The Bell Calls an Envoy
paragraphs: The Cathedral bell gives a single measured stroke. Black wings lift beyond the northern walls. The knights do not turn; Severin's officers tighten their formation as though this arrival was expected.

The Bell Envoy and two Ravens arrive next turn inside the eastern delivery court. Your player phase comes before their first attacks. The Envoy stays planted and attacks adjacent targets, but the Ravens actively pursue beyond the court.

Only three pairs of Ravens arrive: the first with the Envoy, the second two turns later, the final pair four turns later. Occupied arrival tiles queue their units instead of relocating them. The unarmed Envoy fights with its claws; defeat it for 5 Insight and its carried treasure. This fight is optional; Severin remains the sole victory target.

pages.title: The Last Door
paragraphs: Severin's armored knees strike the paving. The defenders hesitate, and the company gathers beneath the Cathedral's closed doors.
His weapon falls against the pale stone. No one speaks. The fountain behind them is still dry; the flowers are untrampled.
The Bishop is still inside. Arlan lifts the latch. The company enters the Cathedral.
